permittedEdits.promptAppend: Full views follow the actual Stage palette before their first paint. Light uses #151515 code and controls, #5c5c5c line numbers, neutral #eaeaea buttons and #d6d6d6 tab indicator with dark hairlines; dark retains its original code/control ink and raises line numbers to #9c9c9c. Preserve all three complete code tabs, their highlighted lines, live Copy feedback, expansion, exact supplied SVGs and native reference artwork. Keep fonts, layout and the complete controller unchanged.

defects.finding: Its visible native fraction and denominator used #6a6a6a on the dark Stage, about 3.37:1.
defects.fix: Use #8c8c8c for dark and #5c5c5c for light compact counters. Preserve all five slides, original text, photos, drum faces, font metrics, transforms and controller. The original native muted ink deliberately changes for readability.

defects.finding: Visible resting glyphs used about 3.37:1 dark ink; selecting a link left other operable links at 0.28 opacity with 3px blur. Active light labels retained pale dark-theme ink.
defects.fix: Use neutral readable inactive/active colors in each actual Stage palette. Keep unselected operable links opaque and unblurred. All original glyph rolls, five/nine-pixel shifts, indicator geometry, delays and controller remain exact.
defects.designDeviation: Native muted ink and the unselected dim/blur styling deliberately change for readability. No owner approval is inferred or claimed.

defects.finding: Light Stage primary labels retained #f1f1f1; the initial full gauge value was nearly indistinguishable from the pale Stage.
defects.fix: Initialize light primary/secondary ink and neutral/dark-orange meter marks before first paint. Preserve captured dark native artwork, all source SVG bytes and the complete usage, billing, compaction, spark and hold models.

defects.finding: Visible dark line numbers used about 3.37:1. Light Stage code and inactive tabs retained #f1f1f1 and became almost invisible.
defects.fix: Raise full dark line numbers and initialize a complete neutral full light palette, including tabs, buttons and their indicator. All three complete code samples, highlighted lines, source SVGs, native artwork, expansion and clipboard controller remain exact.

historicalSelection.note: Measured nonzero foreground/background incomplete rows selected candidates; unmeasured zero ratios are not passes or confirmed defects. Later fresh actual Stage checks establish this phase scope.

beforePaint.limits: Exact zero deletion pairs apply only to the named clipped/transparent initial faces in these captures. Positive Stage-wide deltas can contain compositor differences outside a target; small default-GPU changes are retained, not treated as an exact glyph-mask oracle. This is not all-state drum contrast or universal raster equivalence.

manualReview.rawPolicy: Keep every violation and incomplete result without filtering. The retained Fraction name-rule findings and other incomplete states are separate from this bounded ink repair; earlier primary-name evidence is retained and not upgraded into whole-catalog conformance.

surface.note: The supplied light Stage glow adds only white over #f4f4f4. The listed dark light-theme text is checked against the darker #f4f4f4 surface; dark Stage has a solid #151515 background. This bound is separate from photographic or other component backgrounds.

focused.initialGeometry: Exact DOM rectangles, transforms and font metrics against complete before definitions.
focused.menuStates: Actual Home/End/Escape navigation, operable sibling contrast and original source ownership.
focused.codeStates: All three original code tabs and their full contents.

earlierPaletteRegression.scope: The later exact Fraction contrast CSS is applied to both native comparison sides. The original nine-component palette fixture is unchanged, while the focused checker independently validates the new delta.

retainedAttempts: The first paint diagnostic used a nonexistent runtime pause method. The corrected helper uses the documented suspend API, with the original helper and failure retained.
The first four-component applier did not match whitespace before menu template fields. All replacement plans were guarded before any production write; the exact helper/failure is retained.

The first focused menu oracle required data-source=keyboard after End. Original focus selection can occur before the key handler and retain source=focus. The corrected oracle checks actual selected index and native focus; the accepted report retains its actual observed source.
The first composed palette guard compared cross-realm arrays directly. Matching serialized values are now compared in the same realm, preserving the exact original fixture and later source contract.

The older thirteen-component naming checker still expected Orbit without Target link and changing full Coast pass identities. Its expectations now retain the already shipped visible prefix, stable Coast pass name, complete front/back descriptions and unchanged native naming/pressed-state checks. The initial failure and exact old checker are retained; neither component implementation changes in this phase.
remainingAcceptance: Complete remaining catalog accessibility and precise label applicability review.
Review unmeasured photographic, gradient, SVG/canvas and noninitial states.
Current-source complete startup/readiness and Chrome 4x CPU motion/frame-rate acceptance.
